conversations.title: Plan a weekend in Lisbon with a table

messages.content: Plan a weekend in Lisbon with a table

Here is a quick comparison.

| Option | Cost | Time | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Train | Low | 2 h | Reading on the way |
| Car | Medium | 1.5 h | Flexible stops |
| Flight | High | 1 h + airport | Long distances |

For this distance the train is the easy choice.
